objective: Prove a uniform implication from a full Cartesian power of the unobserved port relation to a lower bound on all bonds with the specified target. Establish whether the converse or bond existence is forced, with genuine controls.
status: Proved. A rectangular power r forces size at least 1+ceil(s/r) for unrestricted support. A neutral-carry and uniform-link cycle ensures a bond of size at most s+3. Matched controls exclude a converse or a guarantee of bond existence from the unobserved relation alone.
title: Forgetting and lower bounds for every support
